label: Driving Distance
tip: Average drive length in yards (measured holes).

label: Driving Accuracy
tip: Percent of tee shots that finish in the fairway.

label: Left Tendency
tip: Percent of tee shots that finish left of the fairway.

label: Right Tendency
tip: Percent of tee shots that finish right of the fairway.

label: Left Rough Tendency
tip: Percent of tee shots that finish in the left rough.

label: Right Rough Tendency
tip: Percent of tee shots that finish in the right rough.

label: Hit Fairway Percentage
tip: Percent of tee shots that finish in the fairway or on the green (shot-level data).

label: Distance to Fwy Edge
tip: Average distance from the edge of the fairway when the fairway is missed.

label: Distance to Fwy Center
tip: Average distance from the center of the fairway when the fairway is hit.

label: Drives in Water
tip: Percent of holes where the tee shot finished in water (lower is better).

label: Greens in Regulation
tip: Percent of holes where the green was hit in regulation.

label: GIR 200+ yds
tip: Greens in regulation when the approach was over 200 yards.

label: GIR 175-200 yds
tip: Greens in regulation from 175-200 yards.

label: GIR 150-175 yds
tip: Greens in regulation from 150-175 yards.

label: GIR 125-150 yds
tip: Greens in regulation from 125-150 yards.

label: GIR <125 yds
tip: Greens in regulation from under 125 yards.

label: GIR Percentage from Fairway
tip: Greens in regulation when the tee shot finished in the fairway.

label: Proximity >200 yds
tip: Average distance from the hole after approaches over 200 yards (fairway).

label: Proximity 175-200 yds
tip: Average distance from the hole after approaches from 175-200 yards.

label: Proximity 150-175 yds
tip: Average distance from the hole after approaches from 150-175 yards.

label: Proximity 125-150 yds
tip: Average distance from the hole after approaches from 125-150 yards.

label: Proximity 50-125 yds
tip: Average distance from the hole after approaches from 50-125 yards.

label: Fairway Proximity
tip: Average distance from the hole after approaches hit from the fairway.

label: Going for Green
tip: Percent of time the player goes for the green on a par 4 or par 5 where it is an option.

label: 50-125 yds Scoring Conversion
tip: Birdie or better percentage after approaches under 125 yards.

label: Approach < 125 yards (RTP Score)
tip: Average score relative to par after approaches from 50-125 yards.

label: Sand Saves
tip: Percent of greenside bunker shots that led to an up-and-down.

label: Scrambling
tip: Percent of missed greens where the player still made par or better.

label: Scrambling Sand
tip: Scrambling percentage from the sand.

label: Scrambling Rough
tip: Scrambling percentage from the rough.

label: Scrambling Other
tip: Scrambling percentage from other locations.

label: Scrambling >30 yds
tip: Scrambling percentage from over 30 yards.

label: Scrambling 20-30 yds
tip: Scrambling percentage from 20-30 yards.

label: Scrambling 10-20 yds
tip: Scrambling percentage from 10-20 yards.

label: Scrambling <10 yds
tip: Scrambling percentage from under 10 yards.

label: Sand Saves >30 yds
tip: Up-and-down percentage from a greenside bunker, over 30 yards.

label: Sand Saves 20-30 yds
tip: Up-and-down percentage from a greenside bunker, 20-30 yards.

label: Sand Saves 10-20 yds
tip: Up-and-down percentage from a greenside bunker, 10-20 yards.

label: Sand Saves <10 yds
tip: Up-and-down percentage from a greenside bunker, under 10 yards.

label: Scrambling Proximity
tip: Average distance from the hole after a shot onto the green from around the green.

label: Scrambling Avg Distance to Hole
tip: Average distance from the hole after the shot that follows a missed green.

label: Proximity Sand
tip: Average distance from the hole after a shot onto the green from a bunker.

label: Proximity Rough
tip: Average distance from the hole after a shot onto the green from the rough.

label: Proximity Other
tip: Average distance from the hole after a shot onto the green from other locations.

label: Proximity >30 yds
tip: Average distance from the hole after a shot onto the green from over 30 yards.

label: Proximity 20-30 yds
tip: Average distance from the hole after a shot onto the green from 20-30 yards.

label: Proximity 10-20 yds
tip: Average distance from the hole after a shot onto the green from 10-20 yards.

label: Proximity <10 yds
tip: Average distance from the hole after a shot onto the green from under 10 yards.

label: Putts per GIR
tip: Average number of putts on greens hit in regulation (lower is better).

label: Feet of Putts Made
tip: Total length, in feet and inches, of all putts holed.

label: Putts Per Round
tip: Total putts in the round.

label: Approach Putt Performance
tip: Average distance left after the first putt.

label: Total Putting
tip: Composite putting rating (rank based).

label: 3-Putt Avoidance
tip: Percent of holes with 3 or more putts (lower is better).

label: Putting 3-5 feet
tip: Percent of putts made from this distance (needs enough attempts, so single rounds are often blank).

label: Putting <5 feet
tip: Percent of putts made from this distance (needs enough attempts, so single rounds are often blank).

label: Putting 4-8 feet
tip: Percent of putts made from this distance (needs enough attempts, so single rounds are often blank).

label: Putting <10 feet
tip: Percent of putts made from this distance (needs enough attempts, so single rounds are often blank).

label: Putting 5-10 feet
tip: Percent of putts made from this distance (needs enough attempts, so single rounds are often blank).

label: Putting 10-15 feet
tip: Percent of putts made from this distance (needs enough attempts, so single rounds are often blank).

label: Putting 15-20 feet
tip: Percent of putts made from this distance (needs enough attempts, so single rounds are often blank).

label: Putting 20-25 feet
tip: Percent of putts made from this distance (needs enough attempts, so single rounds are often blank).

label: Putting >25 feet
tip: Percent of putts made from this distance (needs enough attempts, so single rounds are often blank).

label: Eagles
tip: Holes played at eagle or better.

label: Birdies
tip: Holes played at birdie.

label: Pars
tip: Holes played at par.

label: Bogeys
tip: Holes played at bogey.

label: Double Bogeys
tip: Holes played at double bogey.

label: Others
tip: Holes played at triple bogey or worse.

label: Par 3 Performance
tip: Total strokes relative to par on par 3s.

label: Par 4 Performance
tip: Total strokes relative to par on par 4s.

label: Par 5 Performance
tip: Total strokes relative to par on par 5s.

label: Bogey Avoidance
tip: Percent of holes played at bogey or worse (lower is better).

label: Birdie to Bogey Ratio
tip: Birdies or better divided by bogeys or worse.

label: Birdie/Eagle %
tip: Percent of holes played at birdie or better.

label: Bounce Back
tip: Percent of the time a hole over par is followed by a hole under par.
